falsification_conditions.condition: The asset's price closes above the 200-day moving average by more than 5% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A clear breakout would invalidate the 'HOLD' signal by indicating strong bullish momentum contrary to the blowoff pattern expectation.

falsification_conditions.condition: Average daily trading volume increases by 50% compared to the previous 30-day average within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained extreme volume would contradict the blowoff score's implication of imminent distribution, suggesting instead strong buying pressure.

falsification_conditions.condition: The 14-period RSI (Relative Strength Index) rises above 70 and remains above that level for three consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: An overbought RSI reading would directly contradict the blowoff pattern's typical bearish divergence, invalidating the current 'UNKNOWN' verdict.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
